source.attribution: Luca Pappalardo & Emanuele Massucco (2019), Soccer match event dataset, Figshare; Wyscout. Normalised by Bang On; selected type/tag mappings and regulation-minute calculations. CC BY 4.0.
source.permissionNote: Original Figshare Events/Matches/Players/Teams item licences verified as CC BY 4.0. Historical data, not current PL coverage.

notes: All 380 matches of Premier League 2017/18. Each club archive contains all its events plus opposition shots for its 38 matches; opposition non-shot events are not complete.
Coordinates are source on-ball events, attacking left-to-right in both halves. Integer 0–100 resolution; no off-ball tracking.
xG/xA, precise goalmouth coordinates, pass recipients, possessions, full touches/carries/recoveries and post-shot metrics are not supplied.
Interceptions and sliding tackles are explicit tags, not a complete standalone defensive feed.
Regulation minutes are derived from historical match lineups/substitutions, excluding stoppage time.
Goal area tags are categorical outcomes, not measured goalmouth locations. Own goals remain explicitly tagged, not attributed as attacking goals.
Pattern is derived from event class: ordinary pass/shot versus direct dead-ball delivery. Subsequent set-piece phases are not supplied and are not reconstructed.
